name: actions-pane
description: Live GitHub Actions pane beside the transcript while workflow runs are active: run, jobs and steps with status icons and live durations, drawn like GitHub's run view.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Which runs to watch: commit (HEAD), branch (current branch) or repo (every active run).

lingerSeconds.title: Linger seconds
lingerSeconds.description: How long finished runs stay shown before the pane closes itself. 0 closes at once.

activePollSeconds.title: Active poll seconds
activePollSeconds.description: Poll interval while a run in scope is active (at least 5).

idlePollSeconds.title: Idle poll seconds
idlePollSeconds.description: Poll interval while nothing is active (at least 15).

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the pane when a run starts. Off: status line hint only.
